source.title: You Asked: How Do I Make Streetwear Smart?
source.author: MR PORTER

tips.text: Wear a plain hoodie under a blazer or smart jacket on cooler days.
tips.why: It blends street and tailored clothing and adds a warm layer.

tips.text: When a hoodie goes with tailored pieces, pick one with little or no logo.
tips.why: Loud branding fights with sharper clothes.

tips.text: Choose a mid-weight hoodie to layer under a jacket.
tips.why: A thick one bunches up and looks bulky beneath tailoring.

tips.text: Look to streetwear labels' more refined pieces, such as work jackets, and wear them over a collared shirt.
tips.why: They bridge street style and smart dressing.

tips.text: Swap jeans for tailored trousers, ideally navy, to sharpen a streetwear outfit.
tips.why: Trousers lift the formality while the rest stays relaxed.

tips.text: Keep one small skate detail, such as a belt chain, when you wear smart trousers.
tips.why: It holds on to some street edge.

tips.text: To smarten streetwear, choose minimal low-profile sneakers over chunky trainers.
tips.why: Bulky trainers pull attention away from the rest of the outfit.

tips.text: Plan how street and smart pieces combine instead of throwing them together at random.
tips.why: The mix only works when it looks deliberate.
